states.description: The connection to the Go playback daemon itself is unreachable (StatusSnapshot.reachable === false) while the daemon's own last-known truth -- an actively playing scene with live output -- remains authoritative and displayed, never replaced with a blank/idle placeholder.

A hypothetical upstream AI/automation provider is unreachable while the Go daemon itself is fully reachable and its own truth is completely unaffected (reachable stays true) -- models D-14's 'must not depend on an AI provider' mandate as zero observable coupling: the operator-facing safety surface behaves identically to a fully-healthy daemon.

13-08-01.reason: Plan 13-19's merge (commit a8ccc8fa) consolidated the 9 per-plan design-system/exception-proposals/*.json files into the single canonical design-system/exceptions.json and deleted the proposal directory. DS008 (exception-integrity) audits the ENTIRE exceptions.json manifest regardless of --paths/--proposal scope, so this task's narrowly-scoped literal command now reports every out-of-scope exception record as stale (or, for the 9 --proposal-flag tasks, hits an ENOENT on the deleted proposal file and reports an invalid-exception-record diagnostic instead). Whole-source `node scripts/design-system/check.mjs --all` -- the honest current equivalent of what this command originally intended to prove ('this task's files introduce no unaudited design-system drift') -- is independently, mechanically re-confirmed zero-diagnostic clean this session. The task's own vitest sub-command (unaffected by this issue) already passed unchanged.
